newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ROMA'S DAHLIN RETURNS TO MOENCHENGLADBACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ROMA'S DAHLIN RETURNS TO MOENCHENGLADBACH.

text.p: German first division side Borussia Moenchengladbach have re-signed Swedish striker Martin Dahlin from Serie A club Roma until at least the end of the season.
Business manager Rainer Ruessmann said late on Friday that Moenchengladbach, 10th in the league with just 12 goals from 11 games, also had an option to buy the 28-year-old when the loan period ends.
Dahlin scored 50 goals in 106 games for the Germans but failed to secure a place in the Italian club's first team.
Ruessmann declined to say how much he had paid for Dahlin, who moved to Roma for 5.6 million marks ($3.7 million) in the close season.
He said he planned to register Dahlin on Monday to allow him to play against Bayer Leverkusen next Saturday.

Roma, who have lost two successive matches since beating league champions AC Milan 3-0, were due to face European champions Juventus at home later on Saturday in a match likely to give a clearer picture of their true worth.
